+def make_pairs(users, labels, seed):
+    users = np.asarray(users)
+    labels = np.asarray(labels) > 0.5
+    order = np.argsort(users, kind='stable')
+    sorted_users = users[order]
+    cuts = np.flatnonzero(sorted_users[1:] != sorted_users[:-1]) + 1
+    starts = np.r_[0, cuts]
+    ends = np.r_[cuts, len(order)]

+    neg_parts = []

+        pos = ids[labels[ids]]
+        neg = ids[~labels[ids]]

method_selection.citation: standard hyperparameter search practice (random/grid search, Bergstra & Bengio JMLR 2012); package composition per DCNv2/BPR training setups.
method_selection.why: Validation peaks at epoch 8 (0.601838) and then declines to 0.600686 while training loss continues downward, indicating overfit. This untried card bundles the proven DCN-lite, hybrid-BPR, strong regularization, recency weighting, and early checkpointing interactions rather than retrying weak atoms. Its measured package target of about 0.6047 implies an honest gain near +0.0029 over the current 0.6018 baseline, enough to clear epsilon. Execute the policy-required wide random search with at least 16 stage-1 probes and at least 10 local refinements, logging every configuration and score.

rejected.reason: It matches the requested ablation agenda but spends substantially more runtime rediscovering interactions already established across replicated campaign evidence; the package sweep more directly tunes the known winning interaction.
The curve supports regularization, but this single component has an expected gain around +0.0015, below the +0.002 convergence threshold; the full package has higher expected gain.
This is a closing move requiring an accepted champion configuration; ensembling the current baseline would amplify a weaker parent and forfeit larger single-model gains.

method_selection.why: The learning-curve fields are unavailable, so overfit or underfit cannot be established from the curve. The accepted package already raised primary from 0.6018 to 0.6044, leaving gains near seed noise. Reproducing node_001’s exact configuration across five seeds and per-user rank-averaging directly follows the journal recommendation, validates that improvement, and has benchmark evidence of reaching about 0.6058. The honest expected incremental gain is only roughly +0.0004 to +0.0014, but this is the strongest eligible measured-alive option under the portfolio exclusions.

rejected.reason: It matches the requested ablations but treats excluded overfit/underfit families and is much more expensive before confirming node_001 across seeds.
It treats excluded overfit and should follow replication and identification of the winning package factors; it also includes auxiliary objectives that should not be retried first.

expected_delta_basis: The seed-ensemble card reports measured Pure primary near 0.6058, while node_001 reached 0.6044; seven members spend the available runtime on additional variance cancellation, although returns beyond five are expected to diminish.
